podcast.body: This was the band's first big hit, performed on their television debut on *The Midnight Special* (episode four). From the album *Toulouse Street*, it reached number 11 on the Billboard charts in November 1972. Written by Tom Johnston, the lyrics express a utopian vision of world leaders resolving differences by simply listening to music and discarding conflicts. "Tom Johnston wrote that song and said the lyrics out of this utopian idea that if the leaders of the world got together on some grassy hills somewhere and either smoked enough dope or just sat down and just listened to the music and forgot about all this other bullshit the world would be in much better place."
